decisions.reason: The accepted instruction retains holes in the bushing and sliding mandrel; it does not change the welded-lug hole spacing, fabrication sequence, or face finishing.
Retaining the bushing and sliding-mandrel holes does not change the drawing setup, numbering, or presentation conventions.
The geometry decision does not alter the obligation to deliver a 3D model or its required file formats.
The source resolves component geometry under the bushing-guidance Requirement but does not change the independent obligation to provide the manufacturing drawing set.
The instruction to retain existing holes does not change any dimension-annotation requirement or establish a new annotation value.
